summary: Iteration 4: Partner Console plus the SME broker-review handoff. Backend: 18 pytest tests (meta, stats scoping, case filters, create with auto-assign, status/notes/recommendation flags/review/assign, package, X-API-Key partner API, team CRUD, cyber scan on www.petronas.com MY). 16 pass, 2 fail, both 500s on bad input. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): these flows passed: SME /quote Step 7 -> broker-review -> success (ZIN-FIRE-26113, Bharat, Imran) -> open-in-console showing the LIVE case; Imran agent workflow (schedule -> inspect -> recommendation with 4 flags -> Insurer review); insurer request-justification -> approve, reassign, note, audit trail, API tab; Summary indicators jump to Evidence; annotation-P2-0 detail; P1-P5 thumbs; 6 video frames; machinery (6 rows); prior policy; persona-scoped KPIs (insurer 13 / Ritika 5 / Imran 2); queue search, status, band and flagged filters; Oversight KPIs with 8 Review links; Ritika team add agent, toggle off (persists), duplicate-email toast; cyber scan grade B with 11 findings and history; reset-demo reseeds to 12 cases. No JS errors in the normal flows.

minor.issue: Returns 500. q goes straight into Mongo $regex without re.escape, so an invalid regex throws. Seen in the UI: typing '(' in case-search triggers the 500 and an unhandled promise rejection (Cases.jsx has no .catch), the Emergent dev overlay then blocks clicks, and the count stays stale.
Returns 500 with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'startswith' (cyber_scan.py line 37). The URL needs validating (hostname is None) and the endpoint should return 422.

_cert() (sync socket, 5s timeout) and dns.resolver (4s each) are blocking calls inside an async handler and freeze the event loop for every request. Wrap them in asyncio.to_thread. There is also no SSRF guard: internal hosts and IPs are accepted.
Lead IDs use count_documents+101, so live leads are ZIN-FIRE-26113 while seeded ones are 26001-26012. This is inconsistent, can produce duplicates under concurrency, and there is no unique index.

No state machine. Status can be set back to inspected/assigned on approved cases, cases can be reassigned after approval, and an agent can submit a recommendation before inspection (UI canRecommend also allows it from 'assigned').
Flags on approved cases are never resolved or cleared, so the 'Open flags' and 'Mis-selling flags' KPIs and the flagged filter still count approved cases.
Does not clear the cyber_scans collection, so test scans persist.

ui_bugs.issue: No error handling on the /cases call. A backend error causes an unhandled rejection and a blocking overlay, and no error is shown to the user.
Inspection checklist is saved only in localStorage, not server-side (the brief asks for MongoDB). It is not shared between agent and insurer and is not in the audit trail.

integration_issues.issue: flag-open-* opens the case on the Summary tab, not the Recommendation tab where the flags are.
complystack_last_lead in localStorage keeps showing 'booked' with an open-in-console link to a deleted case ('Case not found').

issues: ComplyStack logo overlaps the PARTNER CONSOLE badge.
Reset demo and SME journey buttons are pushed off-screen.
Sonner toasts at top-right cover the persona switcher for several seconds after each action.
Destructive reset runs with no confirmation and no success toast.

action_items: Escape the q regex in /api/cases with re.escape(q) and add .catch plus an error state to the Cases.jsx fetch
Validate the cyber URL (hostname None -> 422), run _cert/_txt via asyncio.to_thread, and consider blocking private/internal hosts
Generate lead IDs safely (max+1 or a counter) and add a unique index on lead_id
Add status-transition guards (no recommendation before inspection, no changes to approved/declined cases)
Exclude flags on approved/declined cases from the open-flag KPIs and Oversight queue, or mark them resolved
Fix the console header at <=768px (overflow and logo overlap)
Optional: save the checklist server-side, make the Oversight Review link open the Recommendation tab, clear cyber_scans and stale localStorage on reset
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: no Pydantic constraints (empty note text, empty review comment for decline, agent email not validated as EmailStr)
Agent persona can open any case by URL and see the reassign-free view; there is no scope check on /cases/{id} (acceptable for a demo without login)
Deactivating an agent leaves their open cases assigned to them with no reassignment prompt
SmeSubmit stores the raw journey dict unvalidated in Mongo

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; issues are edge cases and responsive layout)
